name: Organizers' drawing
description: The course as the organizers drew it in their preliminary 3D model, dronehacks-course-v3.obj. Made by course_map_tools/make_map_from_organizers_model.py. Our phone scan of the real course shows several walls in different places, so treat this as the plan, not the built course.
